d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Honduras vs Japan in Group L of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Japan dominated in a 7-0 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha as Maki Kitahara struck a hat-trick, including a penalty, Kakeru Saito scored twice and Riku Nakashima and Takeshi Wada were also on target. Japan finish third in Group L and must wait to see if they advance as one of the best third-placed teams, while Honduras exit the tournament.
